subject: OncoHealth: launch ops briefing & kickoff expectations
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sanjay Reddy <sanjay@oncohealth.com>, OncoHealth Ops <ops@oncohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OncoHealth: launch ops briefing & kickoff expectations

Team — handing this across to CS for implementation planning. Below is a concise summary and asks so we can lock in owners and a kickoff date. Attaching the signed SOW and the kickoff MAP workbook (high-level runbook).

Deal summary (short):
- Customer: OncoHealth (regional US provider; clinical analytics product)
- ACV: $420k annual (RDW-12457) + one-time integration services in SOW
- Primary use: private Redwood Dedicated cluster for inference (PHI, SOC2 constraint) + streaming responses and embeddings for search/rerank
- Contract start: 2028-03-20; target go-live window: 2028-05-01 to 2028-05-15

Technical & compliance notes (important for implementation):
- Private deployment required: VPC peering + customer-managed KMS (OncoHealth requires HSM-backed keys).
- Data flow: only de-identified patient text allowed; customer will provide a pre-processed feed via SFTP (ops@oncohealth.com) and push to our ingestion endpoint.
- SSO/SCIM required (Okta). They want provisioning automated before the dev environment handover.
- Region: us-east (their primary infra) — prefer to run Dedicated nodes in ashburn region.
- Latency SLO: 150ms p95 for short-chat/assist endpoints; batching allowed for embeddings jobs outside prime hours.

Programmatic expectations:
- CS to own implementation plan, runbook updates, and test validation (staging -> prod).
- I recommend a two-week integration sprint (staging validation + security signoff) then a one-week pilot with 50 users.

Immediate asks from Sales (me):
1) Please confirm CS owner and primary backup.
2) Suggest kickoff slots next week (Mon/Wed afternoon PT) for initial alignment call with OncoHealth and Infra.
3) Confirm whether we need an on-prem checklist or if Dedicated VPC is sufficient (I copied their ops address in case we need details).

Attachments: signed_SOW_OncoHealth.pdf (contract + security appendix), OncoHealth-MAP-v1.xlsx (integration checklist, test cases, dataset expectations)

Notes from customer meetings:
- Sanjay is the BA and will own user acceptance; asks for weekly 30-min checkpoints during pilot.
- They expect strict logging/audit trail; asked about retention windows — propose default 30 days for KV cache and 90 days for audit logs unless security requests otherwise.

Irene
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OncoHealth: launch ops briefing & kickoff expectations

Thanks Irene — good summary. I’ll take primary ownership for the onboarding program and assign a dedicated Implementation Manager. Preliminary notes:

- Assignment: Lauren Bishop will be IM lead for the integration (she knows the Dedicated onboarding flows and Okta/SCIM templating). Lauren, can you confirm capacity?
- Security: We need the HSM/KMS contact and their key rotation policy. If OncoHealth insists on an on-prem HSM we will escalate to Private deployment checklist (longer lead time).
- Staging estate: We will schedule a staging cluster in us-east for 2 weeks starting 2028-03-22 to validate connectivity and perf.

Next steps I’ll take this week:
1) Lauren, please draft a 4-week implementation plan in the runbook format (owner, milestones, acceptance criteria).
2) I’ll schedule a 60-min kickoff with OncoHealth stakeholders (Sanjay + ops) for Wed 2028-03-14 13:30 PT — Irene can you confirm that works for them?
3) I’ll add a security checklist ticket (Jira: SUP-8372) and link to the SOW appendix.

Assigning Lauren now — Lauren, you’re the primary IM; Dev (me) is program lead and backup.

Dev Patel
Head of Customer Implementation
Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OncoHealth: launch ops briefing & kickoff expectations

Happy to take this on — capacity looks fine (can start ramping next Mon). Quick clarifications:

- Okta/SCIM: I’ll reuse the Okta mapping from our Hospica template but will confirm attribute mappings with Sanjay (need orgUnit and is_admin flags).
- KMS: If they provide an AWS KMS key with ExternalAccount permissions, we can proceed; if they require HSM-on-prem, we’ll need a Private deployment timeline (adds ~6 weeks).
- Audit retention: propose 90 days for logs, 30 days for KV cache as Irene suggested — will surface to security for approval.

Deliverables I’ll produce by Tue 2028-03-14:
- Draft implementation plan (timeline + owners)
- Test-case matrix for staging validation (embedding quality checks, latency runs, SCIM provision tests)
- Pre-kickoff questionnaire for OncoHealth (connectivity, SFTP sample, Okta admin contact)

Irene — please confirm the Wed 3/14 13:30 PT kickoff or let me know alternate windows. I’ll start a shared runbook doc and populate the first draft.

Lauren Bishop
Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Sanjay / OncoHealth team — thanks for the productive discussions this month. Looping in Lauren Bishop (Implementation Manager) and Dev Patel (Program lead) from Redwood to run the onboarding.

Proposed kickoff: Wed, 14 Mar 2028, 13:30 PT (60 mins). Agenda: introductions, review runbook + SOW security appendix, Okta/SCIM mapping, SFTP sample delivery, staging/perf plan, and acceptance criteria for pilot.

Lauren will follow up with a short pre-kickoff questionnaire and the initial runbook. Dev will own program-level milestones and the Jira ticket for security signoff.

Attachments included: signed_SOW_OncoHealth.pdf; OncoHealth-MAP-v1.xlsx (integration checklist).

Sanjay — can you confirm attendee list and that Wed 13:30 PT works? If not, Irene and I can propose alternate windows (Mon/Wed afternoon PT).
